text:
Olive: Big thanks to @Hector and @Samira for rescuing the office bonsai after the meeting room window was left open. You two braved the cold, repotted it, and saved our tiny tree :seedling: :heart:
Hector: ha, team effort. Samira found the tiny root ball and Ben grabbed the potting mix. Also shoutout to @plants-bot for the watering reminder earlier.
Samira: honestly the bonsai looked grateful. Also adding a sticky to Meeting Room B: "Close the window, no bonsai casualties" :memo:
Ben: sending a couple of pastry vouchers to Hector & Samira. Small treat for plant heroics.
plants-bot: Maintenance log: BONSAI-23 watered and repotted at 2026-02-14T08:12:03Z. Reminder set for weekly check. :white_check_mark:
Olive: tiny moments like this deserve a shoutout. Adding a one-liner to the kudos doc: "Hector & Samira: bonsai saviors and cozy-room champions." :sparkles:
